title: A host ignores SQLITE_BUSY from closing a connection with a live statement, clears its database handle, and later dereferences that NULL handle.
live_note: The defect is in the binding, not in SQLite: this corpus pins no binding release, and the host arm builds the 3.53.3 amalgamation, so whether a row is live in a given binding version is not established here.

host-asan.observed: re-anchored (task-013): the real crash is a Java NullPointerException on close-while-busy — adjacent, not a C SQLite-pointer null-deref (see negative search)

status: host ASan arm recorded, oracle 'null-deref'; NOTE.md records why it is not reproduced
